head_lede: 30 years. 10 years online. One new chapter.
quote1: "For the last decade, I have been sharing my life online. What started in 2016 with putting my thoughts on a blog has now become the videos you see today on YouTube and other social media platforms."
quote2: "But lately, I have been pouring my heart into something completely different."
bio_text: Oluwapeyibomi is a twenty-something digital creator who is all about romanticising daily life and building a community rooted in personal growth — faith, lifestyle, personal challenges, and community conversations.
timeline1_text: Putting her thoughts into words for the first time — no plan, no audience in mind, just the habit of writing things down.
timeline2_text: The blog became videos, and the videos became a world — years of sharing life online across YouTube and social media.
timeline3_text: Personal growth. Faith. Romanticising daily life. Stepping outside her comfort zone. Building community, one honest post at a time.
timeline4_text: Something new, quietly taking shape — the next chapter in her story.
milestone_label: 30 YEARS. 10 YEARS ONLINE. ONE NEW CHAPTER.
milestone_text: This September, Oluwapeyibomi turns 30 — and marks a decade of sharing her life publicly. The two anniversaries meet at the same moment something new, quietly built, is about to arrive.
cta_heading: Be there when the next chapter opens.
